_doc: 小朋友鎮的生活英文任務（2026-11-08 P3 A 段）。grocery＝超市購物清單（喬爺爺給清單，到商店找李老闆照清單拿東西結帳；每一行算 1 題）；waiter＝餐廳服務生（湯姆主廚，聽客人點餐、把對的餐點放上托盤，每位客人算 1 題）；lost＝迷路的小麥克（聽他講怎麼走、選他住哪一間，再帶他走回家，各算 1 題；路線由程式照地圖算）；class＝林老師的英文課（題目從學習站 data/textbook.js 的五上／五下課本句子出，載不到就用句型 patterns.js 有 tb 標記的例句）；daily＝每日鎮民委託（依台北日期每天 3 個，stat 是哪一種任務做了幾次）。pay：每題答對 perQ 金幣、整個任務全對再 +allRight。英文全部原創。

grocery.intro: Hello! My legs are tired today. Can you go to the shop for me? Here is my shopping list.
grocery.introZh: 你好！我今天腳很累。可以幫我去商店買東西嗎？這是我的購物清單。
grocery.thanks: Wonderful! You got everything on my list. Thank you so much!
grocery.thanksZh: 太棒了！清單上的東西你都買到了，非常謝謝你！

waiter.intro: We are very busy today! Can you be my waiter? Listen to each customer and bring the right food.
waiter.introZh: 今天超級忙！你可以當我的服務生嗎？聽每位客人點什麼，把對的餐點送過去。
waiter.thanks: Great job! The customers are happy, and so am I.
waiter.thanksZh: 做得好！客人很開心，我也很開心。
say: I'm so hungry! I want {a} and {b}, please.

lost.hello: Excuse me... I'm lost. Can you help me go home?
lost.helloZh: 不好意思……我迷路了。你可以帶我回家嗎？
lost.how: Walk straight down this road to the big road. Turn {turn}. My house is the {nth} house on your {side}. It's next to the {next}.
lost.howZh: 沿著這條路一直走到大馬路，{turnZh}轉。我家是你{sideZh}手邊的第{nthZh}間，在{nextZh}旁邊。
lost.walk: Max will follow you. Take him to his front door!
lost.walkZh: 小麥克會跟著你走。帶他走到他家門口！
lost.wrong: Hmm... this is not my house.
lost.home: This is my house! Thank you for walking me home. Bye-bye!
lost.homeZh: 這是我家！謝謝你帶我回家，掰掰！

class.intro: Welcome to English class! Today's lesson is from your textbook: {unit}. Let's begin!
class.introZh: 歡迎來上英文課！今天的課是你課本裡的：{unit}。我們開始吧！
class.zh2en: How do we say this in English?
class.thanks: Class is over. You did a great job today!
class.thanksZh: 下課了，你今天表現得很好！

daily.en: Grandpa Joe: Please help me buy food today.
daily.zh: 喬爺爺：今天請幫我買一次東西。

daily.en: Lily: Grandpa Joe needs a lot of food. Shop for him two times.
daily.zh: 莉莉：喬爺爺要買很多東西，幫他買兩次。

daily.en: Chef Tom: The restaurant is busy. Please work one shift as a waiter.
daily.zh: 湯姆主廚：餐廳好忙，請當一次服務生。

daily.en: Chef Tom: Bring the right food to five customers.
daily.zh: 湯姆主廚：把對的餐點送給 5 位客人。

daily.en: Lily: Little Max is lost again. Please take him home.
daily.zh: 莉莉：小麥克又迷路了，請帶他回家。

daily.en: Ms. Lin: Come to my English class today.
daily.zh: 林老師：今天來上一堂英文課。

daily.en: Ms. Lin: Take two English lessons today.
daily.zh: 林老師：今天上兩堂英文課。

daily.en: Ben: Talk with three people in town.
daily.zh: 小班：跟小鎮裡的三個人聊天。

daily.en: Grandpa Joe: Do any job in town one time.
daily.zh: 喬爺爺：在小鎮做一次任何工作（有執照的職業）。
